strategy: Use the real Danone PPTX template as the source of truth. Select a semantic intent, copy the preferred layout or sample slide, then fill existing placeholders instead of recreating layout geometry from HTML. Layouts are chosen from ACTUAL sample slides in the template — not all 252 layouts have sample slides.

opening-cover.notes: Use for the first slide. Preserve the large Danone circle/photo geometry from the source layout.

contents.notes: Use for agenda pages. Keep item numbering and image treatment inherited from the template.

section-photo.notes: Use for section breaks and photography-led pages. Image is copied to ppt/media/ and blip reference updated.

big-message.preferred_layout: Blue: Full White - Big Text / No Caps
fallback_layouts: Blue: Text w/ Large Image - Big Text
big-message.notes: Use for single takeaways. Prefer No Caps variants to avoid forced uppercase.

two-column.notes: Use for balanced argument or comparison pages.

three-column.notes: Use for scenario pages with three categories (pain points, data, products).

image-content.notes: Use when a real Danone/product/photo asset carries the page. Image is copied to ppt/media/ and blip reference updated.

chart-or-table.notes: Use native PowerPoint charts/tables where possible so the output remains editable.

closing.notes: Use for thank-you and final action slides.

decision-grid.notes: VP decision cards (2x2 or 1x4). Fill multiple body placeholders with decision card text.

positioning.notes: Two-column contrast: before (soft bg, muted) vs after (solid theme bg, white text).

fallback_layouts: Blue: Full White - Big Text / No Caps
master-storyline.notes: Strategic mainline narrative. Big headline with minimal supporting text.

data-flywheel.notes: Circular data-learning loop (6 steps). Distribute across 4 body placeholders.

experience-space.notes: 4-column physical experience journey map with arrow connectors.

fallback_layouts: Blue: Full White - Big Text / No Caps
naming-direction.notes: Naming territories + recommendation. Title + body text.

service-architecture.notes: Service lifecycle matrix table. Two-column layout.

stat-grid.preferred_layout: Blue: Full White - Big Text / Two numbers
stat-grid.notes: Data highlights with big numbers. Distribute stats across body placeholders.

flow.notes: Process steps with arrow connectors. Distribute steps across body placeholders.

fallback_layouts: Blue: Full White - Big Text / No Caps
big-quote.notes: Full-page centered quote. Title as attribution, quote as body text.
